name: research
description: Find information and verify it before trusting it — search the live web with Exa, answer only from citable official sources or refuse (cite-or-refuse), rule every factual claim in a document VALID / INVALID / INCONCLUSIVE with sources (fact-check-document), fetch pages that block ordinary scraping (403/429, Cloudflare, CAPTCHA, geo-restriction, JS-only) through BrightData's Web Unlocker (web-unlocker), and automate a real headless Chromium browser (Playwright) for JS-heavy or interactive pages. Supply an Exa API key to enable web search; supply Cloudflare Access credentials to enable Playwright.

EXA_API_KEY.title: Exa API Key
EXA_API_KEY.description: API key for Exa web search (https://dashboard.exa.ai/api-keys), sent as the x-api-key header to the hosted MCP at https://mcp.exa.ai/mcp. Stored in your system keychain, never written to the repo; maintainer copy is SOPS-encrypted in secrets/exa.sops.json.

CF_ACCESS_CLIENT_ID.title: Cloudflare Access Client ID
CF_ACCESS_CLIENT_ID.description: The CF-Access-Client-Id for the mcp.loup-peluso.com Access service token (public identifier, ends in .access). Sent as a request header so Cloudflare Access lets the request through at the edge.

CF_ACCESS_CLIENT_SECRET.title: Cloudflare Access Client Secret
CF_ACCESS_CLIENT_SECRET.description: The CF-Access-Client-Secret paired with the Client ID. Stored in your system keychain, never written to the repo.
